questions.title: Comprehensive Load Balancing Architecture
questions.question:
Design a comprehensive load balancing architecture for a global e-commerce platform.

Requirements:
- Handle 1 million requests/minute globally
- Serve users from 5 regions: NA, SA, EU, Asia, Australia
- Support web traffic (HTTP/HTTPS), API traffic, and WebSocket connections
- Enable canary deployments and A/B testing
- SSL/TLS termination
- DDoS protection and rate limiting
- Route /api/* to backend services, /static/* to CDN
- Sticky sessions for shopping cart
- 99.99% availability

Design architecture covering:
1. Global load balancing strategy (GSLB, DNS, latency-based routing)
2. Regional load balancer setup (redundancy, failover)
3. Layer 4 vs Layer 7 decision for each traffic type
4. Load balancing algorithms for different services
5. Health check configuration (frequency, thresholds)
6. SSL/TLS termination and certificate management
7. Session affinity implementation
8. Content-based routing rules
9. Auto-scaling integration
10. Canary deployment traffic splitting
11. Security measures (DDoS, WAF, rate limiting)
12. Monitoring and alerting strategy

Include: architecture diagram, configuration examples (NGINX/HAProxy/AWS), failover scenarios, capacity calculations, and cost analysis.
questions.realWorldScenario: Building production-grade global load balancing infrastructure
